explain.title: How it's calculated
explain.cards: Cards in work, at purchase price
explain.cardsNote: Gift cards aren't included in assets — you didn't pay for them, but their income counts.
explain.dailyFormula: Card value in BTC × annual rate ÷ 365 × BTC rate, summed over working cards.
explain.dailyNote: An estimate at the current rate. The rate can change, and the dollar amount follows the BTC price.
explain.rateNote: The rate comes from Binance and updates in real time.
